title: How is "mieux" the correct answer here???  | French Q & A | KwizIQ French

facts.fact: A community member on the page summarizes the distinction as "mieux = better, meilleur = the best"; this is a user's informal gloss, not a vendor statement.
The question was posted 5 months before the page was captured.
The question thread shows 1 like and 4 answers at the time of capture.
The original poster, who is a C1-level KwizIQ community member, reports choosing "meilleur" for the blank and being told it was incorrect.
facts.quote: i chose meilleur and i was told incorrect...so confused
